decisions.quote: More specifically, our findings replicate the reported associations between ALA and lower disability as well as preserved brain structure. The consistency across independent cohorts strengthens the notion that ALA may play a protective role in MS-related neurodegeneration. However, several discrepancies also emerged. We found a positive association between ALA and T2-weighted lesion counts at baseline in multivariable models.
decisions.reason: While the authors replicate the associations of higher serum ALA with lower disability and larger brain volume, their replication analyses also tested T2 lesion counts and explicitly report a discrepancy with the original study (a positive baseline association with T2 lesions in multivariable models not observed in Cortese et al.), making the replication outcome mixed under the codebook.
